title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 197 (Ratification may be expressed or implied)

content.overview: Ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.
content.glance: Ratification may be express or implied from the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts were done.
content.study: Ratification may be expressed or may be implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done. Illustrations: (a) A buys goods for B without authority; B afterwards sells them on his own account — implied ratification; (b) A lends B’s money to C without authority; B accepts interest from C — implied ratification.

sections.heading: Express or implied
sections.body: Ratification may be expressed or implied in the conduct of the person on whose behalf the acts are done.

provisions.title: Ratification may be expressed or implied

examples.title: Implied ratification by subsequent dealing
examples.body: A, without authority, buys goods for B. Afterwards B sells them to C on his own account. B’s conduct implies ratification of the purchase.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 197 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Look for express words or conduct implying adoption of the unauthorized act.
